interpretations: For every player with a postseason batting record and a matching `player` row, average their nonmissing postseason `double` values across records; divide that average by the overall average of the players’ averages; subtract the average index of players with the same `bats` value; return the 10 largest gaps, placing missing gaps last, with `player_id`, `bats`, average doubles, index, and gap at full precision
queries:
WITH player_averages AS (
    SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS average_doubles
    FROM player AS p
    JOIN batting_postseason AS bp ON bp.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           bats,
           average_doubles,
           average_doubles / (SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM player_averages) AS "index"
    FROM player_averages
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           bats,
           average_doubles,
           "index",
           "index" - AVG("index") OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap
    FROM indexed
)
SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, "index", gap
FROM gaps
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
